explanation: Pineapple contains bromelain, an enzyme that breaks down gelatin's proteins. Tinned (canned) pineapple works fine, because heating destroys the enzyme. Fresh kiwifruit and papaya cause the same problem.

claims.text: Fresh pineapple contains bromelain, a protein-digesting enzyme that breaks down gelatin, so a gelatin dessert containing fresh pineapple fails to set.
Tinned pineapple does not stop gelatin setting, because the heat of canning inactivates bromelain.
Fresh kiwifruit and papaya also contain protein-digesting enzymes (actinidin and papain) that stop gelatin from setting.
